args: Why does loyalty member revenue read as €0 for three small verticals?

Books & Stationery, Food & Coffee, and Pet Supplies show real loyalty members and orders in one report but €0 member revenue in another — is this a currency-conversion gap, and does it change the loyalty cost conclusion?
